title: Good food in Ubi, Hougang, Woodleigh, Paya Lebar and Eunos
method: Candidates are places within 1,000 m of an exit of Ubi, Hougang, Kovan, Woodleigh, Paya Lebar or Eunos MRT station that food guides recommend by name. Each guide listed under Sources was read on the retrieval date; a place counts once per guide.

A place needs at least two different publishers to be a candidate. Rank is by the number of distinct publishers, then the number of guides, then the most recent guide date, then name. The top 100 open places are listed.

Mall places were checked against the directories of PLQ Mall, SingPost Centre, KINEX, The Woodleigh Mall and Paya Lebar Square on the retrieval date; a place the directory no longer lists is left out as closed. Hawker centres, coffee shops and shophouses have no directory, so a place there counts as open only when a guide from 2022 or later names it; older ones are left out as unverified.

Google ratings and review counts could not be retrieved, so they play no part. The ranking measures how often independent writers recommend a place, not how it tastes, and it favours places that food media cover.
calorie_method: Each figure is an estimate for a reference dish, not a measurement of the place's own dish. Where Yeo et al. (2021) measured the same or a comparable Singapore hawker meal, its portion and nutrient values are used. Otherwise the closest U.S. survey recipe from FoodData Central (FNDDS) is used, with a stated portion.
A dish matched to the measured dish or a close variant is labelled an estimate. A dish matched to a generic equivalent is labelled approximate and names its equivalent and source.
Bars split energy into carbohydrate, protein and fat at 4, 4 and 9 kcal per gram. That split can differ by a few kilocalories from the stated total energy, which comes from the source.
Buffets, shared plates and drinks with no fixed portion are marked not estimable rather than guessed.

map.projection: Equirectangular, scaled by the cosine of the centre latitude; x grows east, y grows south.

areas.label: Ubi
areas.summary: 1 of the top 100 is in Ubi: Knots Cafe & Living (rank 1), for its Knots Waffle Brekkie. 6 places are left out as unverified, because no guide has named them since 2022.

areas.label: Hougang & Kovan
areas.summary: 26 of the top 100 are in Hougang & Kovan: 4 at Kovan 209, 2 at Hougang Hainanese Village Centre and 20 at other addresses. The most recommended are Punggol Nasi Lemak Centre (Nasi lemak with chicken wing), Lola's Cafe (Eggs Benedict) and Nakhon Kitchen (Pad Thai). 1 recommended place has closed and is left out: Hatter Street. 6 places are left out as unverified, because no guide has named them since 2022.

areas.label: Woodleigh
areas.summary: 19 of the top 100 are in Woodleigh: 11 at Woodleigh Village Hawker Centre, 7 at The Woodleigh Mall and 1 at another address. The most recommended are Bulgogi Syo (Ginseng chicken stew), Surrey Hills Grocer (Fried Chicken Stack) and Tiong Bahru Bakery (Kouign amann). 6 recommended places have closed and are left out: Beans.Factory, Brewerkz, Hollin, Lam's Noodle & Salt Baked Chicken, Project Acai and VeganBurg Woodleigh.

areas.label: Paya Lebar
areas.summary: 42 of the top 100 are in Paya Lebar: 14 at SingPost Centre, 8 at Haig Road Food Centre, 7 at PLQ Mall, 7 at Paya Lebar Square, 2 at KINEX and 4 at other addresses. The most recommended are Tipsy Bird Gastrobar (Moonlight truffle beef hor fun), Fong Sheng Hao (Patty with egg cheese toast) and 5 Little Bears (Taichung braised pork rice). 17 recommended places have closed and are left out: 800 Degrees Woodfired Pizza, ChaTraMue, Chong Qing Premium Grilled Fish, Chu Yi Jia, Grove, Hokkai Small Town, Hoshino Coffee, Jimmy Monkey Cafe, Lucky Bird, Mom's Touch, Morphine Coffee, Nuodle, Osomatsu Japanese Kitchen & Bar, Patisserie CLE, Soul Coffee, The Providore and Wursthans Switzerland. 4 places are left out as unverified, because no guide has named them since 2022.

areas.label: Eunos
areas.summary: 12 of the top 100 are in Eunos: 5 at Eunos Crescent Food Centre, 5 at Geylang Serai Food Centre and 2 at other addresses. The most recommended are VeganBurg (Char-grilled satay burger), Hai Xian Zhi Jia (Sliced fish soup) and Mami Midah Briyani (Chicken briyani). 9 places are left out as unverified, because no guide has named them since 2022.

nutrition.citation: Yeo PLQ, Bi X, Yeo MTY, Henry CJ. Energy Content and Nutrient Profiles of Frequently Consumed Meals in Singapore. Foods. 2021;10(7):1659.
nutrition.note: 45 meals bought from a Kopitiam food court in Singapore and measured by near-infrared spectroscopy (Calorie Answer). Tables 1-3 give the portion weight and energy, protein, fat and carbohydrate per 100 g; yeo2021.csv transcribes them with the per-serving values of Tables 4-6 beside them for cross-checking.

nutrition.citation: U.S. Department of Agriculture, Agricultural Research Service. FoodData Central: Survey Foods (FNDDS), release 2024-10-31.
nutrition.note: U.S. recipes, not Singapore ones. Used only where Yeo et al. (2021) has no comparable dish; fndds.csv holds the rows used, extracted by extract_fndds.py.
